reversals.evidence: Stage-1 says the prompt never states the objective. But an evaluate item that makes the learner supply the criterion is legitimate (answer is explicitly conditional 'if affordable access is the priority'). Fix is one added sentence ('The town's priority is affordable access for all residents.'). Reason to restore: the selection keeps FIVE J items on the same water-point/maintenance case (J-013, J-015, J-017, J-P02, J-P03; selector itself notes 'reused across 5 J items'), and V-009 is the only transport/single-operator case in 1.2. V-009 is not the same case as J-017. Also inconsistent with V-1.1-009 (kept) whose prompt feeds every pro-training cue.

Only application of the trade-union definition (elected representative presenting complaints = collective voice); 2.2.1 has V-001 definition but no application item selected. J-005, its stage-1 counterpart, was removed as redundant with J-004, so nothing replaces it. Stage-1 verdict KEEP, dropped without a reason in the selection (no supersedes entry).

Adds the fact that craft-union membership can span several employers, which no selected card states; V-011 (revised) only covers manual/skilled overlap. Cue-heavy prompt ('two features distinguishing craft membership from a broad grouping') so revise prompt to 'State one way a craft union differs from a union for all workers in one firm'.

Formal vs informal firms IS examined: QP-2021-P1 Q5 'Explain the two main differences between formal and informal firms' (src/QP-2021-P1.txt L136); ER answer 'not registered (Ministry of Trade and SME development); do not pay tax' (2021-ER-layout.txt L40-44, note the extracted layout puts the 'poorly answered, could not differentiate formal and informal' comment above Q4 but it belongs to Q5). Syllabus has no 'informal' (grep confirmed none in syllabus.txt) so entitlement is absent, but it is the one 2.1 concept the exam asked that nothing in the selection teaches. Stage-1 right that the card is circular; replace with the ER two-difference card.
